segment.description: Nonconnah Creek mainstem, the Memphis-area urban waterway and Mississippi River tributary (HUC 08010211), Shelby County, TN. Cataloged as a no-stocking-program warmwater creek. USGS maintains stream gauges on the reach — e.g., 'NONCONNAH CREEK NEAR GERMANTOWN, TN' (07032200, gauge altitude 262.81 ft, HUC 08010211) and 'NONCONNAH CREEK AT RIVERPORT RD AT MEMPHIS, TN' (07032252, gauge altitude 174.60 ft) — but neither gauge carries a water-temperature record in NWIS.
segment.boundaries: Nonconnah Creek mainstem in Shelby County from the Germantown area down to the Mississippi River confluence at Memphis; catalog entry covers the whole creek.

coldSource.notes: Elevation is the USGS gauge altitude (NAVD88) at the near-Germantown gauge (https://waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/site/?sites=07032200&siteOutput=expanded&format=rdb); it characterizes the lowland urban fall line of the creek. No cold-water source (dam release or spring) documented anywhere consulted.

holdover.detail: No trout presence of any kind documented for this creek in TWRA's stocking table or the Trout Management Plan; with no stocking program there is no put-and-take cycle whose carryover could be documented. Control-style record.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout record. TWRA Trout Management Plan 2017-2027: 'Wild trout are generally limited to East Tennessee's mountain streams.' No consulted source places any trout in Nonconnah Creek.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: The creek is absent from TWRA's stocking table (no trout program of any kind) and no cold-water source or trout record exists for this lowland urban Memphis creek.

sourcesChecked: https://waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/site/?bBox=-90.35,34.95,-89.75,35.30&format=rdb&siteStatus=all&siteOutput=expanded (area site inventory used to enumerate Memphis-area gauges)
